content.text:
## Welcome to Mapping Attacks to Business Impacts

You will get the practical version, not fluff.

# Teach Me Like I'm 10

Mapping Attacks to Business Impacts in plain English: understand the moving parts, spot the failure points, and use them well.

## Core concepts

- Business impact analysis
- attack mapping
- stakeholder communication

Keep it simple. Map the idea, then apply it.

# Hands-on exercise

Write a short checklist or script that applies the lesson in a safe lab setting.

# Real-world

Use Mapping Attacks to Business Impacts to solve a real operational problem, not just to memorize terms.

# Memory aid

Use one sentence, one diagram, one quick recall drill.

# Reflection

What changed in how you think about the problem? What would you do tomorrow?

## Wrap-up

If you can explain Mapping Attacks to Business Impacts simply, you actually know it.
